page_187.body_text: ​FTCWatch Source FTCWatch How to Cite the Source Description FTC:Watch is a legal news service focused on antitrust, consumer protection and privacy enforcement developments initiated by the Federal Trade Commission.  With an emphasis on advance news, political analysis and investigative reporting, FTC:Watch is the only service that covers not only the Federal Trade Commission’s Bureaus of Competition and Consumer Protection as closely as it does, but also the civil and criminal investigations at the antitrust division of the Department of Justice.  It is part of the MLex family of publications. FTCWatch, has been critically covering antitrust, privacy, and consumer protection enforcements by the FTC, DOJ, and State Attorneys General, for the past 40 years. It comes out twice a month which means the content is extremely in-depth and provides the full picture and behinds the scenes look at the agencies work. Our journalists are full time experts with deep technical understanding of this part of the law with experience working for the FTC, DOJ, and as specialized attorneys. Their level of expertise combined with relationships they’ve developed over the years, provides them with an ability to uniquely interpret the regulatory and political issues, and demonstrate their impact on the law. Our technical analysis assists law firms, corporations, and government regulators monitor the evolving legal hurdles around these topics so they can provide the most pressing information to their clients and decision makers. Our journalists are full time experts with deep technical understanding of this part of the law with experience working for the FTC, DOJ, and as specialized attorneys. However, there are many other conditions for using Gartner content. See Important Notes below. Description Gartner, Inc. is an American research and advisory firm focusing on business and technology topics. Gartner provides its products and services through research reports, conferences, and consulting. Time Period Covered Varies. Gartner has been around since the 1980s Access Cornerstone does not have an account. Gartner does not allow one-off document or data purchases as of beginning of 2024. We would need a research subscription that would allow unlimited access to research and our experts and that would cost $100,000 to $500,000 and it could only be used for non-litigation, generally internal business purposes. Contact: Use IR to contact Gartner. Do not contact directly. Cost Varies Important Notes We must always get Gartner's permission to mention, use, or share its content. It has extensive guidelines for using its content: Content Compliance Policy | Gartner Generally, Gartner does not allow use of its content in litigation. However, there might be  a very rare exception if we are compelled by court order or other legal obligation to produce Gartner IP. The process to get approval will take 45-60 days and possibly longer. A protective order must cover the Gartner content. Gartner sales reps, analysts, experts, etc., cannot approve use of its content. Only a member of the Gartner Content Compliance team or its delegates (trained non-content compliance associates) may approve external use requests. Gartner also does not allow its content to be used in competition law matters, such as joint venture filings, acquisitions, or mergers. AI Restrictions Needless to say, Gartner does not allow use of outside artificial intelligence tools on its content. page_211.body_text: Ibbotson Cost of Capital Yearbook Source Ibbotson Cost of Capital Yearbook How to Cite the Source Ibbotson Cost of Capital <yyyy> Yearbook Description The Ibbotson® Cost of Capital Yearbook is a source for business valuation statistics needed for industry analyses.  The yearbook is a reference for professionals performing discounted cash flow analyses. Calculated values include cost of equity and weighted average cost of capital estimates. Explanations of formulas used in calculating cost of capital Data provided for more than 300 industries, listed by SIC code Five measures of cost of equity and weighted average cost of capital Detailed statistics for sales, profitability, capitalization, beta, multiples, ratios, equity returns, and capital structure Time Period Covered CRSF Library has 2000-2012 editions. Access Yearbooks are in CRSF 20th Floor Library.  Or email #Information Resources Cost Free Contact (within CR or Vendor) Cornerstone Comments Ibbotson Methodology for Calculating Company Betas Ibbotson Methodology for Calculating Industry Betas This publication is distinct from the Ibbotson SBBI Yearbook which come in Classic and Valuation editions The yearbook is divided into two sections: 1) the description of methods used 2007 and 2013 and 2) valuation statistics by SIC code . The yearbook includes data available through March of the edition year and ships in June.  Most corporations end their fiscal year at the calendar year-end.  By the end of March, many of these companies have reported their previous year's financial results.  For this reason, March was selected by Ibbotson to be the Yearbook reporting month. page_217.body_text: Inside Mortgage Finance Source Inside Mortgage Finance How to Cite the Source Inside Mortgage Finance Publications Description Inside Mortgage Finance publishes a newsletter covering legislative, political and regulatory issues, as well as industry news, trends, analysis and statistics and rankings. Coverage includes mortgage issues, such as the government-sponsored enterprises, the mortgage and asset-backed securities markets, the non-agency non-conforming market, mortgage insurance, subprime lending, servicing, predatory lending, technology innovations, profitable operations, e-commerce and consumer compliance issues.  The company also publishes the following data: Primary residential mortgage market data (mortgage origination, sale and purchase activity; mortgage rates and terms; mortgage originations by state; top mortgage originators; top online mortgage originators; top mortgage servicers; replenishment rates for top mortgage servicers; mortgage servicer delinquency rates; top mortgage conduits; top subprime mortgage originators; top subprime mortgage servicers; government-related mortgage limits; Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac activity; top Ginnie Mae mortgage-backed security issuers; top Ginnie Mae mortgage-backed security servicers; mortgage servicing outstanding and servicing transfers; private mortgage insurance activity; reinsurance premiums ceded to top lender captives; new home sales by type of financing; thrift industry mortgage activity) Secondary mortgage market and MBS data (secondary mortgage market and mbs data; mortgage securitization rates; the mortgage-related security market; the non-agency mortgage security market; the alt a mortgage security market; the b&c (subprime) mortgage security market; the jumbo mortgage security market; fannie mae and freddie mac market activity; top sellers to gse mbs pools; the agency-backed cmo/remic market; the agency-backed strip security market; the arm security market; the home-equity loan security market; mortgage-related security investors; the non-mortgage asset backed security market; non-agency mbs/abs ratings; the commercial & multifamily mortgage security market; mbs/abs trustees). Time Period Covered Data tends to be recent (i.e., the last few years) though some data is available going back farther. Access Please email #Information Resources to request data from IMF. Cost The Information Resources recently subscribed to IMF’s current and historical PDF database of data ( Mortgage Market Statistical Annual ). The subscription is valid through June 2016. As with our other sources, we will bill back for the charts that we download.  The cost will be $550/chart (in PDF or XLS) up to a lifetime max of $5000 per case.  As well we will bill back for copies from the books to help us recover our costs. Subscriptions to the newsletters range from approximately $200 to $2,000 per year. Single articles may be purchased for $50 per article. Industry reports cost from $300 to $800 per report. Contact (within CR or Vendor) Inside Mortgage Finance website Cornerstone Comments The subscription allows us to incorporate their data into our reports both in text and chart formats. There are, however, 2 restrictions on the use of the data and 1 requirement. We cannot directly copy an IMF chart into our report. We can create our own charts/graphs and incorporate the IMF data into those however. We cannot turn over their raw data to anyone outside Cornerstone (excluding our expert as he/she is considered a contractor for this purpose). This means we cannot turn over their charts and data as back-up. The opposing side would need to arrange to get the data themselves (generally it is fairly inexpensive). Please cite IMF in the following manner: Mortgage Market Statistical Annual, Copyright 2014 (the current year should always be used). page_228.body_text: ​ I HS MARKIT Source IHS Markit Ltd (now owned by S&P Global ) How to Cite the Source IHS Markit Description IHS Markit was founded in 2001 as the first independent source of credit derivative pricing. They stopped selling to us ~2016 but since the merger with S&P in 2022, they are willing to sell to us again. IHS Markit is recognized as the leading provider of pricing data for the Credit Default Swap market. With access to a wide range of data sources, we are in a unique position to offer the best, most relevant and up to date prices in the marketplace. Their CDS pricing service uses books of record feeds, dealer runs and clearing submissions as data fuel to calculate observable pricing throughout the day along with liquidity and credit sensitivities information. IHS Markit CDS Single Name Pricing Methodology.pdf IHS Markit provides CDS sector curve data with granular market breakdown by rating, region and sector. CDS sector curve data is delivered on a Sameday T+0 (several local snaps) and End of Day T+1 basis and offer market-driven par spreads across the full term structure for each rating, region and sector combination. IHS Markit CDS Sector Curve Methodology and User Guide.pdf . Sample of CDS_Sector_Curves_20220425.xlsx Time Period Covered 2006-Present Access Will sell on a project basis on a project-by-project basis for litigation, CDS, Bond, and Loan. page_232.body_text: ​ Infegy Source Infegy How to Cite the Source Infegy, Inc. Description A Social Monitoring and Listening platform. Infegy has some TikTok data, where as other Social moditoring platforms do not have this data at the moment. They are mainly designed for marketers rather than Cornerstone's purposes.  They seem to use sample sets of all types of posts and extrapolate from there for overall statistics, so it generally does not seem to be a better option than Brandwatch for things that are already of Brandwatch (such as Twitter) Their approach to data acquisition is problematic for a few reasons: They do not have a formal partnership with any social media platforms.  They crawl and collect data from the platforms whose terms of service prohibit such behavior.  This also prevents them from guaranteering coverage. More importantly, Legal has advised us against not only programmatically collecting data from third-party web sites against their terms of service, but also against relying on any data that we believe to be collected by anyone against these ToS. Unless Infegy can represent to us that they're in compliance, we understand that relying on their data exposes us to certain risks. Furthermore, while the Infegy API product that I tested provides access to TikTok search and the resulting URLs and metadata, it does not provide the actual videos. If we wanted to analyze the actual videos, we would need to programmatically collect those. Again, Legal has advised us against doing so. Time Period Covered Infegy scrapes data from TikTok posts dating back to 2019 and data from other social media platforms (including Instagram and YouTube) dating back to around 2015. The types of TikTok data Infegy scrapes include hash tags, likes, shares, and info from authors' bio pages. Data ranges by package - 37 months to 18 years Access https://www.infegy.com/ Contact: Nathan Buss nathan.buss@infegy.com Cost As of July 2025 : Access to their database is on a subscription basis in tiers though they do offer assistance on a one off basis with 1 month, 3 month, and 6 month terms. Cost for a subscription range from $24,000 to $39,000+. Cost for a one off project are as follows : To begin project pricing, first determine your annual costs, then calculate using the following percentages: ● 1 Month Term - 15% of Annual Total ● 3 Month Term - 33% of Annual Total ● 6 Month Term - 60% of Annual Total * Dedicated CSM support & 3 training sessions available for additional $2,250 for project terms. See Infegy Pricing Overview for July 2025 cost estimate Infegy Pricing Overview_July 2025.pdf Important Notes Note that DSC noted the limitations on the search capacity and content access on their platforms. In particular, they note that Infegy was vetted from the perspective not of user-level data for analysis, but with an eye towards identifying, analyzing, and characterizing TikTok posts focused on a particular topic over a period of time. Limitations on Search capabilities :  Because the main content of TikTok is video but all we can search is text—in either the "body" field that the user fills out or the "description" field, which contains any text the user overlays in the video (e.g., an overlaid hashtag), we're able to search for posts based on only the text of the post, not the video content (e.g., an image or audio). That said, almost every post has text in its "body" field.  The text is usually short (e.g., just a hashtag), but we'd still probably pick up a lot of the posts. Limitations on Content access: Infegy cannot provide access to the original TikTok video content itself. The data would rather come in the form of a spreadsheet containing information like date, body, likes, comments, engagement, and followers for a given post that falls under the specified search criteria. AI Restrictions At Cornerstone we Cannot : "Directly or indirectly: reverse engineer, decompile, disassemble or otherwise attempt to discover the source code, object code or underlying structure, ideas, know-how or algorithms relevant to the Services or any software, documentation or data related to the Services ("Software"); or modify, translate, or create derivative works based on the Services or any Software (except to the extent expressly permitted by Infegy or authorized within the Services)." Please check with IR before using AI on any Infegy products or data. AI Definitions/Capabilities Infegy AI : AI tool within Infegy that uses natural language processing to enhance social listening features. Infegy AI Personas + Audiences : Uncover hidden subgroups within your target market. Dive deep into interests, passions, and sentiments. Craft laser-focused strategies with rich demographic insights. Infegy AI Summarization : Distill complex data into clear, actionable summaries. Identify key trends and narratives at a glance. Drill down effortlessly for deeper insights into trends and niche conversations. Infegy AI Assist : Intuitively generate comprehensive queries, even with limited Boolean logic knowledge. Discover hidden insights by automatically incorporating relevant terms and filters you might overlook. Empower analysts of all experience levels to unlock deeper social data insights. Query Monitors : Schedule weekly or daily detailed digests of conversations within your identified topic or brand. Set alerts for when your brand or topic experiences significant changes in volume or sentiment, and set how sensitive you'd like these alerts. Gain a detailed overview of the conversation, including sentiment, top topics, and key narratives, within the social conversation. Updated 12/15/2025_SAT

page_243.body_text: ​ Kinetiq-TV Broadcast Data Source ​Kinetiq How to Cite the Source ​Kinetiq Description ​Data Coverage and Capabilities: Kinetiq transcribes and provides access to recent TV broadcasts on near real-time basis Search queries on for video clips (via the web platform) and transcripts (via web platform and API) allow for common Boolean operators as well as word proximity searches. Basic boolean AND, OR, and NOT (e.g., blank AND blue, "flavored water" NOT "sparkling water") Proximity search via ~ (e.g., "cat dog fish" ~ 14 returns all items containing "cat," "dog," and "fish" within 14 words of one another) Grouping with parentheses (e.g., ("flavored water" OR "sparkling water") NOT bottles) Stemming via # (e.g., red# returns items containing the terms "red," "reds," "redone," "Redding") Availability as of the following years for the following national news channels: CNBC (2010) CNN (2010) Fox Business (2010) Fox News (2010) MSNBC (2010) HLN (2010) Bloomberg (2010) MSNBC (2010) BBC America (2010) Al Jazeera (2010) OAN (2021) Newsmax (2020) Good coverage across all 210 Nielsen Designated Market Areas (DMA's) which comprise the US TV broadcast market. For example, we can access the following in the New York Metro DMA: WNET (2010) WABC (2010) WCBS (2010) WNBC (2010) Ability to access Nielsen ratings data corresponding to the transcripts we identify via our queries. Time Period Covered ​~2010 to present Access API (via Data Science) and web access for individual users. API access includes just transcripts and transcript meta data​.  Web access includes access to video clips.  You can pull transcript excerpts centered around key word searches. There are a limited number of seats available to the web platform. Requestors must begin research with transcripts via the API. Contact #Data Science Center with requests. Send queries for the API search to #Data Science Center.  Please include the following information: Key words Date Range Channels of interest If the team identifies specified video clips , the case team/#Data Science Center  can then contact IR to assign seat to the web platform. Cost API access: Per search:  $200 (up to 5k results) Includes excerpts of results Up to 10 full transcripts : $350 per request High-volume transcript requests: $2500 per calendar month Web access: ​For web access needed on a short term basis: $500 per user per calendar week. Access requested during the week would be granted beginning on Monday the following week. If the request is urgent, access will be granted ASAP during the week requested and will be effective through the end of that week (for example, if requested urgently on a Wednesday and provided access on Thursday, the user will have until EOD Friday to access the web platform). For teams that need greater access over a longer period of time: $2500 per calendar month for up 5 users. Contact (within CR or Vendor) ​API: #Data Science Center Web: #Information Resources (please start your requests with the API, as stated above) Cornerstone Comments ​ Sample or additional information (including cross references) ​

page_248.body_text: Kindle ebooks Source Amazon Kindle ebooks How to Cite the Source If doing a general cite to the book or quoting a small portion of the book: Cite the book and say it's the Kindle edition. If you need to cite page numbers, we should purchase a print edition. Description Information Resources can purchase Kindle versions of books. This would mostly be for the purpose of reviewing them or using them internally. Kindle books are only licensed to one user (email address) and can't be printed or shared, so we recommend getting print versions for case use and production. For more information about purchasing print books from Amazon, see this page . Another option is for IR to purchase a Kindle ebook that will be given to the opposing party. After purchase, we will give you a web link from Amazon that should be given to the opposing side for them to access the book. (If you use the link, the book will be licensed to you and not available to anyone else.) Time Period Covered Varies based on the text being requested. Access Amazon.com . Contact: Ask #Information Resources to purchase full text items. Cost Varies based on the text being requested. Important Notes For many Kindle ebooks, you won't need Kindle Software to read them. You can use Kindle for Web, which lets you read your Kindle books on your mobile or desktop browser. If you don't have a Kindle e-reader or the Kindle app, Kindle for Web is perfect for you. To buy and read Kindle content using Kindle for Web, go to read.amazon.com on your web browser. Sign in with your Amazon account. Any existing titles you previously purchased will appear under the "All Titles" tab. You can read directly from your web browser and don't need to download an app. Note : Not all titles are available to be read using Kindle for Web. Download the Kindle app or read them on your Kindle e-reader. To get the Kindle app, please contact #IT Help Desk. They will likely need to get permission from the security team to make sure it's safe to install on the Cornerstone network. Here is a document containing ebook options and their availability/restrictions to use : eBook Providers Cheat Sheet_May 2025.docx AI Restrictions AI Definitions/Capabilities Updated 10/21/2025_SAT

page_257.body_text: Lex Machina Source Lex Machina How to Cite the Source Lex Machina Description Lex Machina is a litigation database that also provides legal analytics. You can search for cases and parties, view dockets, pull case lists and case documents, similar to PACER. With Legal Analytics you can gain strategic insights about trends in case timing, resolutions, damages awards, findings, and remedies.  For example, you can find out how likely a judge is to transfer a case to another venue, how much experience opposing counsel has in front of a specific judge, and what law firms represent a specific company in this area of litigation. The data can be used in evaluating business development and marketing opportunities, assessing your case strategy, determining motion strategy, and explore potential damages scenarios.  The Case List Analyzer enables you to filter to the cases that you care about, and generate trends, charts, and tables that you can use directly for your case or to share with your client. Lex Machina Overview - Training Video (January 2025) Case Tracking Lex Machina has a case tracking feature that will email updates to a case docket, including Attorney and Party information.  Lex Machina will add attorneys to the Summary that are identified in Pro Hac Vice motions and Substitution of Attorney motions. However, Lex Machina does not mark attorneys or law firms as withdrawn after they are substituted out . Please check the filings for the most up to date information about attorneys.  If you need docket tracks that keep track of all this information, you can set up alerts through the Law360 or IR with Lexis Courtlink. Case Search Keyword search across cases, case documents, and docket entry text. There are numerous ways to filter cases through the search.  Lex Machina also allows the user download case lists (up to 1000 cases) with customizable columns, including Damages amounts.  An example of the download is linked to here . Courts and Judges Search Lex Machina allows you to view and drill down by looking at a specific court or judge.  The data is displayed in charts and graphs supported by interactive case lists.  For example, you can view Summary Information, District Court Cases, Patent Case Damages and Judges Information through the Courts and Judges Module.   Below is a screenshot of Summary Data. Read our Quick Guide for step by step instructions on how to navigate in Lex Machina: - http://pages.lexmachina.com/rs/098-SHZ-498/images/QuickGuidesComplete.pdf Watch our six part Legal Analytics training videos, ranging from 2 to 6 minutes in duration: - https://law.lexmachina.com/help/video-tutorials/lex-machina/overview Case Tracking Lex Machina has a case tracking feature that will email updates to a case docket, including Attorney and Party information.  Lex Machina will add attorneys to the Summary that are identified in Pro Hac Vice motions and Substitution of Attorney motions.  However, Lex Machina does not mark attorneys or law firms as withdrawn after they are substituted out .  Please check the filings for the most up to date information about attorneys.  If you need docket tracks that keep track of all this information, you can set up alerts through the DSC or IR with Lexis Courtlink. Time Period Covered Federal: 2000-current for IP; 2009-current for Securities State: 2016-current Access You can self-register by entering your email address when prompted. https://law.lexmachina.com/enterprise/cornerstone.com You will then receive an email with a link to register your account and create a password. Contact: support@lexmachina.com Cost Free Important Notes AI Restrictions At Cornerstone we cannot : "load any Content into a large language model, generative artificial intelligence technology, or any other similar technology or device." AI Definitions/Capabilities 1. Definition of artificial intelligence :  sees the definition as a moving target and always changing Lex Machina uses more large language models (LLM) and natual language processes Lex Machina uses a small subset of data - those from court 2. Restrictions to AI : Lex Machina is not working with generative AI The databases and its workers are restricted from using outside AI systems 3. Future plans with AI : Currently do not plan to replace workers with AI Adding more class action and state data Have AI collect the data but use legal professionals to review and use engineers to check on the AI system 4. Effects of AI on Lex Machina's growth : As new courts are added more analytics can be drawn from the data which will speed up the process and data can be analyzed faster 5. Concerns about AI : Worried about mistakes by AI - use humans to check the data/analystics collected Use tagging to train the data Updated 9/26/25_SRC

Together, they explain the financial theory behind the demonstrated practical application and clarify relevant case and statute law. This edition also includes an extensive glossary of financial terms. Description ALM Global's Law.com platform provides news, developments and impactful trends in the legal industry.  Law.com has over 18 online US national and regional legal publications that deliver news, rankings, reports, and strategy.  Some of the ALM publications included are National Law Journal, Corporate Counsel, and American Lawyer. How do you currently allow others to use your data with external AI? Do you see that as an issue – if so, what are your plans to combat that? "We do not allow outside parties to use our data, and our IT team puts safeguards around the scraping of our content." Additional Information? ALM has internal guidelines for the use of AI to make internal staff aware of the benefits and pitfalls of tools available. Updated 12/29/2025_bmc

The best practice is to sign out or shut down after you finish using it.  Scroll down to CLOSE, right click and select SIGN OUT or SHUT DOWN. If you simply choose close in Workspace or close the application window to exit Workspace, Workspace's processes will continue to run and the project code that you entered will continue to be in effect. When you reopen Workspace, you will see that prior project code greyed out in the top right corner of your screen.  You can click on the three dots under the greyed-out project code to enter a new project code. As of July 2026 all users with an LSEG Workspace license have access to the AI feature. LSEG's AI - Explainability Note describes how they use AI in the new AI Search feature. Key features : Natural language search : Ask questions in plain English using the Workspace search bar, Workspace Launcher or by selecting the AI button, and receive answers sourced from a broad range of financial data, documents, and news. Multi-turn chats : Continue asking follow-up questions with full conversational context, including exploring insights and analysing data sets. In-line citations for documents and data : Answers include clear, clickable citations with snippet previews. You can also follow a deep link from the side panel to open relevant Workspace applications directly. For document-based citations, clicking a citation opens the source document in a dedicated canvas view. For structured data – such as fundamentals, estimates, pricing, FX, fixed income, deals, and ESG – citations appear inline at the point of use, so every figure can be traced back to its source. When data is presented in a table, each value carries its own citation. Data visualisation : Quantitative responses are automatically rendered as charts where appropriate, supporting a range of chart types including line, bar, radar, scatter, and waterfall. See What chart types does Workspace AI Search support? for full details. Chat history : Recent chats are automatically named based on your query and can be renamed, so you can easily find and revisit previous questions and responses. Copy : Copy full responses (including tables and charts with formatting) or specific excerpts. Response feedback : Provide feedback to help us improve the quality of the answers. Source MarketAxess TRACE trade 
database Description MarketAxess was formed in April 2000.  
MarketAxess offers fully-disclosed electronic trading in U.S. high-grade 
corporates, Eurobonds, emerging markets, high yield/crossover, credit default 
swaps (CDS) and U.S. agency securities. Time Period 
Covered Historical trade data is available dating from 
the inception of the TRACE initiative (July 2002) to the 
present Access By custom order.  Contact #Information Resources Cost Varies Contact (within CR or 
Vendor) Most recent contact: Brandon Neufeld Data Sales Office    +1 212-813-6245 bneufeld@marketaxess.com Past contacts: General Sales BTsales@marketaxess.com (BT is their BondTicker 
service) Client Services Tim McDonald TMcDonald@marketaxess.com (212) 
813-6287 or Nicole Testa: NTesta@marketaxess.com Data 
Sales Office    +1 (212) 813-6167 ntesta@marketaxess.com Cornerstone Comments Purchase process can take time, so plan ahead as much as possible. When we decide to buy data, we have to agree to the terms of use in an email that our MarketAxess rep sends us. Then MarketAxess asks its accounting department to send us an invoice, and this sometimes takes a day to turn around. When we get the invoice, we have to fill out a wire transfer request form and give it to our accounting department. Typically they process wire transfers once a week, so we have to specify if we want it done as soon as possible and ask to get a copy of the email that shows it was completed. A wire transfer is processed at noon and it usually takes a couple of hours before we get notice that it was successful. Sometimes showing this email to our MarketAxess rep is enough and she will send the data, but other times she wants her accounting department to confirm before she sends the data. She may be able to send the data right away or it may take another day. (Keep in mind this all takes place on business days only.) MarketAxess does not have enhanced TRACE data for agency bonds - you can get that from FINRA . MarketAxess may charge more for data than FINRA. Licensing terms for Cornerstone: The historical data is provided for a one-time fee, will be billed upon agreement of these terms and is not subject to any further payment obligations. This data may be used for internal use, or to create and distribute, internally or externally, written (including electronic) works in the ordinary course of the customer’s business that refer to selected limited portions of the data, so long as such works, individually or cumulatively, do not serve as a functional substitute for a paying user-vendor relationship between any third-party recipient of such work and MA or, in the case of an entity that is in such a relationship with MA, as a functional substitute for designating an additional authorized user within such. Additionally, any use within such works will acknowledge MarketAxess Corp. as the source. Client may provide the data to third parties to support the client’s internal business purposes, and shall be responsible for such third parties’ compliance with the foregoing terms.  Client represents that it has in place agreements or understandings with such third parties confirming that MA data may only be used in furtherance of the client’s internal business purposes. Enhanced Historical Data from FINRA has additional fields not included in MarketAxess data. The data is in fact more complete (e.g., it contains certain fields that are not part of the MarketAxess dataset) although it is less "clean" than the data provided by MarketAxess. Money Market Funds in Morningstar 
Principia After speaking 
with Morningstar Principia product support team, we have learned 
that: 1) Because of low interest to advisors 
and low reporting interest on the part of the funds, Morningstar did not start 
tracking money market mutual funds until sometime in 2006.  There are no money 
market funds in the Dec 2005 data set. Morningstar support used Fidelity Cash 
Reserves (FDRXX) as a test for this. FDRXX was not a fund in the 
dataset. 2) Morningstar only has data on a small 
sliver of the universe of money market funds. 3) There is some money market fund data 
on the July 2007 data set. The charge for this is $400. They can ship us the 
disc but also set up an FTP transfer so we could search the data set today. But 
again, money market funds do not seem to be a Morningstar strength. Also, Cornerstone subscribes to 
the CRSP mutual 
fund database . One of the data codes is for Money Market funds 
(see page 15 of this PDF http://www .crsp.com/documentation/pdfs/MFDB_Guide.pdf ) You may find what you need there freely. Just email #CRSP Mutual Fund DB and 
someone from the Boston office can run the search for 
you. ​

to Cite the Source Mortgage 
Bankers Association Description The Mortgage Bankers Association is a trade association 
representing the real estate finance industry. The MBAA conducts surveys and issues commentaries on the 
mortgage and mortgage-related markets: Weekly economic 
commentaries; Mortgage finance and economic commentaries (typically 
issued monthly); Mortgage finance and economic forecasts (typically 
issued monthly); Outlook for the industry report by the council to shape 
change; Commercial/multifamily quarterly data book (quarterly 
collection of trends and conditions in the commercial/multifamily mortgage 
industry.  It contains important analysis, trends and highlights that occurred 
within the commercial real estate finance industry within the previous 
quarter.); Weekly mortgage applications survey (includes percent 
changes in number and dollar volume of applications from a week, a month and a 
year; average loan size; average contract interest rates and corresponding 
points for six popular mortgage products; the refinance and ARM shares of 
applications, by application number and dollar amount. Available by subscription 
only; 1990-present.); Numerous benchmarking surveys and 
studies; National delinquency survey (Based on a sample of more 
than 44 million mortgage loans serviced by mortgage companies, commercial banks, 
thrifts, credit unions and others, NDS provides quarterly delinquency and 
foreclosure statistics at the national, regional and state levels.  Delinquency 
and foreclosure measures are broken out into loan type (prime, subprime, VA and 
FHA) and fixed and adjustable rate products.  At each geographic classification, 
there are 7 measures: total delinquencies, delinquency by past due category 
(30-59 days, 60-89 days and 90 days and over), new foreclosures, foreclosure 
inventory, and seriously delinquent.  The total number of loans serviced each 
quarter, as compiled through the survey, is also included in the 
data.); Mortgage originations summary data book (includes a 
collection of summary origination reports such as origination totals by state, 
origination totals by state and purchaser type, origination totals by state/loan 
purpose/loan type and the top 100 lenders for each state ranked by origination 
volume; cost: $2,000); Mortgage originations survey (mortgage origination 
activity during the first and second quarters for Mid-year and third and fourth 
quarters for Year-end.  This survey collects detailed information on first-lien 
and second-lien originations for single family properties.  New information 
collected includes origination data on first-time homebuyers, housing type 
(single-family attached, single-family detached, etc.) and some additional 
mortgage products; cost: approximately $200 per 
report); Subprime mortgage originations survey (detailed 
information on first-lien and second-lien subprime originations for 
single-family properties, including origination data on delivery channel, 
amortization type, FICO & LTV distributions, occupancy status, housing type 
and other mortgage categories; approximately $200 per 
report); Annual originations rankings (individual companies' 
origination volumes across different roles, investor groups, property types, 
finance structures and originating office location; approximately $300 per 
report); Annual origination volume summation (aggregate data on 
the commercial/multifamily origination market, including totals across different 
roles, investor groups, property types and finance structures; approximately 
$300 per report); Annual report on multifamily lending (synopsis of the 
U.S. multifamily originations market.  It combines MBA survey information and 
other industry data sources to estimate the total multifamily origination 
activity in the U.S.—including both larger-balance and smaller-balance 
multifamily loans.  Aggregate origination volumes along with rankings of 
multifamily originators are included. $250 per 
report). Quarterly commercial/multifamily mortgage banking 
originations survey (survey of commercial/multifamily mortgage banker 
originations provides quarter year updates on changes in the originations 
market.  The report details changes in the volume of loans originated and breaks 
the data down by property type and by investor 
type.); Commercial/multifamily mortgage delinquency 
rates Commercial/multifamily mortgage debt 
outstanding Commercial/multifamily mortgage servicer 
rankings Time 
Period Covered Generally, 
data is available from 2000-present, though some data sets are available over a 
shorter time period. Access MBAA website Cost Commentaries 
are typically free, as are some data sets; the more detailed reports and 
statistics are generally associated with a 
fee. Contact

Reports NASDAQ OMX publishes two types of short sale files based on the trading 
activity on The NASDAQ Stock Market (NASDAQ), NASDAQ OMX BX (BX) and NASDAQ OMX PSX (PSX) market 
systems: The Daily Short Sale Volume Files reflect the aggregate number of shares 
executed on the NASDAQ, BX and PSX markets during regular trading hours. At the 
security level, NASDAQ OMX shows the volume for executed short sale trades as 
well as the total trading volume for NASDAQ, BX and PSX markets. Because NASDAQ, 
BX and PSX market participants may trade all U.S. exchange-listed securities, 
the file includes short sale data for NASDAQ-, NYSE- and regional 
exchange-listed securities. The Monthly Short Sale Transaction Files provide a trade-by-trade record of 
all short sales executed on the NASDAQ, BX and PSX execution systems and 
reported to a consolidated tape in NASDAQ-, NYSE-, and regional exchange-listed 
securities. Within these files, NASDAQ OMX provides trade details including the 
transaction time, price and number of shares for every short sale transaction. Sale File Format and

page_309.body_text: ​ Numerator Source Numerator How to Cite the Source Numerator Description Numerator is a data and technology company that provides a comprehensive, 360-degree view of consumer behavior by tracking the "what, where, and why" of every purchase. Unlike traditional market research firms that rely on fragmented store-level data, Numerator utilizes a massive, single-source "OmniPanel" of over 1 million U.S. households who share their buying habits directly via a receipt-scanning mobile app. This "zero-party" data approach allows the company to track more than 2 billion shopping trips across all retail channels, including e-commerce, warehouse clubs, and convenience stores—offering brands a "total commerce" perspective that legacy systems often miss. Time Period Covered Numerator's core purchase data from its OmniPanel tracks back to 2014 with a robust, comparable benchmark established in 2019 while its legacy archives for advertising and promotional data extend as far back as the 1990s Access Provide one-off requests, reach out to #Information Resources for access. Contact: Reach out to #Information Resources Cost $20,000-$100,000.  Please reach out to #Information Resources . Important Notes Only provide social media data for subscribers. See document for more information on media stations tracked: General Media Spend Tracking Universe (2).pdf Advertiser quick pivot tab can be provided to organize the data how you would like: Sample Offline Media Spend Numerator Report.xlsm Methodology in how they capture the ads. For digital specifically, they capture across about 10,000 sites. This document details the methodology and approach. Ad Intel Research Methodology Deck.pdf AI Restrictions Numerator strictly prohibits the use of automated bots or scraping tools to extract its data for training external AI models. To protect proprietary information, users are also restricted from uploading Numerator's reports into public AI platforms. Additionally, while their native AI tool, Nexa, provides deep insights, it is governed by rules that prevent the de-anonymization of consumers or the reverse-engineering of the company's technology. AI Definitions/Capabilities Beyond just tracking transactions, Numerator bridges the gap between consumer attitudes and actual behavior through its "Verified Voices" platform and advanced AI integrations. By connecting with verified buyers for on-demand surveys, the company helps brands understand the specific motivations behind a purchase and identify the "Say-Do" gap between what shoppers claim and what they actually buy. Recently, Numerator has further modernized its offerings with "Nexa," a conversational AI agent that allows users to ask complex business questions in natural language, enabling brands to instantly turn deep consumer insights into actionable growth strategies. Updated 3/31/26_rk

page_322.body_text: PACER - Additional Information From http://pacer.psc.uscourts.gov/pacerdesc.html on 7/15/09 Table of Contents 1. Available Information 2. Cost 3. Searching PACER 4. Expert information in PACER 5. Docket Abbreviations Public Access to Court Electronic Records (PACER) is an electronic public access service that allows users to obtain case and docket information from Federal Appellate, District and Bankruptcy courts, and the U.S. Party/Case Index via the Internet. PACER is a service of the United States Judiciary. The PACER Service Center is run by the Administrative Office of the United States Courts. Available Information The PACER System offers electronic access to case dockets to retrieve information such as: A listing of all parties and participants including judges, attorneys, and trustees A compilation of case related information such as cause of action, nature of suit , and dollar demand A chronology of dates of case events entered in the case record A claims registry A listing of new cases each day Appellate court opinions Judgments or case status Types of documents filed for certain cases Imaged copies of documents Cost Access to court documents costs $0.10 per page. The cost to access a single document is capped at $3.00, the equivalent of 30 pages. The cap does not apply to name searches, reports that are not case-specific and transcripts of federal court proceedings. By Judicial Conference policy, if your usage does not exceed $15 ($10 for usage prior to 04/01/2012) in a quarter, fees for that quarter are waived, effectively making the service free for most users. Conference Approves Fee Increase In September 2011, the Judicial Conference of the United States authorized an increase in the Judiciary's electronic public access fee in response to increasing costs for maintaining and enhancing the electronic public access system. The increase in the electronic public access (EPA) fee, from $.08 to $.10 per page, will take effect on April 1, 2012. The change is needed to continue to support and improve the Public Access to Court Electronic Records (PACER) system, and to develop and implement the next generation of the Judiciary's Case Management/Electronic Case Filing system. The EPA fee has not been increased since 2005. As mandated by Congress, the EPA program is funded entirely through user fees set by the Conference. The Conference was mindful of the impact such an increase could have on other public entities and on public users accessing the system to obtain information on a particular case. For this reason, local, state, and federal government agencies will be exempted from the increase for three years. Moreover, PACER users who do not accrue charges of more than $15 in a quarterly billing cycle would not be charged a fee. (The current exemption is $10 per quarter.) The expanded exemption means that 75 to 80 percent of all users will still pay no fees. Searching PACER (from http://pacer.psc.uscourts.gov/faq.html#CR2 ) You may search by case number, party name, social security number, or tax identification number in the U.S. Bankruptcy Courts. You may search by case number, party name or filing date range in the U.S. District Courts. You may search by case number or party name in the U.S. Courts of Appeals. Expert information in PACER (Cornerstone-created) Q: Can I get expert names, reports, affidavits, depositions and/or trial transcripts from PACER? A: PACER offers an up-to-date docket, which includes title and filing date and sometimes description of all motions, which often include the name(s) of expert(s). Judicial orders and minutes are also listed. Each of these motions and orders can be purchased. If experts were named, these documents will contain the expert names. Expert reports and affidavits can also be purchased if they were filed with the court. They are often filed as attachments to motions. Sometimes expert reports are exchanged but not filed with the court. These will not be available. Deposition transcripts are occasionally attached to motions and can be purchased through PACER. Usually deposition and trial transcripts can only be purchased through the court reporter and are expensive if available. IR can help you identify the court reporter and determine cost. Q: Can I search PACER by expert name to find other cases in which an expert has been named? A: No. Q: Is there a way to find out if an expert has been Dauberted? If you know the case, this can be seen from PACER. Otherwise, see http://crikit/Information_Resources/Page_2#Where_do_I_get_Daubert_information.3f Docket Abbreviations The clerk of each federal district or bankruptcy court can set a system of abbreviations, called "flags",  that are used on dockets rather like tags used in CRIKIT.  When used, they will be on the upper right corner of the docket.  For a translation of these abbreviations, click on the "court info" bubble adjacent to your court of interest on PACER Web Links .  Details of the abbreviations used in that court are listed under the heading "Flag Definitions."  For an example, see the Court Info for California Northern District Court ​

The primary criteria for publishing a paper are its quality and importance to the field of finance, without undue regard to its technical difficulty. Finance is interpreted broadly to include the interface between finance and economics. The Review is sponsored by The Society for Financial Studies. page_347.body_text: ​RoyaltyStat Source RoyaltyStat How to Cite the Source RoyaltyStat Description RoyaltyStat is a subscription database of royalty rates and license agreements compiled from the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Edgar Archive. RoyaltyStat contains comparable royalty rates for valuing (or licensing) intangible assets, including patents and trademarks. Every license agreement in RoyaltyStat contains at least one numerical (disclosed, non-redacted) royalty rate, and the database is updated every business day. RoyaltyStatreports the highest among tiered royalty rates. RoyaltyStat is useful for: Finding royalty rates for licensing intangible property; Finding reasonable or comparable royalty rates; Determining buy-in payments for cost-sharing arrangements under transfer pricing regulations; Purchase price allocation; Establishing damages in intellectual property disputes; and Valuing intangible property for mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, bankruptcy, or other transactions. How to download Bond Data from Capital IQ 
(Excel) Note:  The source of Capital IQ bond data is FT Interactive (FTI).  Note that 
FTI provides a closing bid quote on each day. This closing bid quote may be 
based on transaction prices if available, or based on a matrix price that 
incorporates dealer quotes, credit ratings, stock price volatility, industry and 
company-specific news and other factors if transaction prices are not available. 
There is no way to differentiate the extent to which an FTI reported price is 
based on transactions or is influenced by these various factors. FTI does not 
report trading volume. Enable Capital IQ Excel Plug-In Find bond CIQ: Right Click on empty cell in which you want to

Filter by Security Type: Fixed Income Securities--> Go --> Select relevant 
Corporate Debt --> Add --> (Optional: Choose "Apply in cells across a 
row") --> OK Insert column of Dates Insert bond price formula: Right Click on empty cell in which you want to 
insert the formula--> Insert Formula --> Enter Identifier: Cell (Click 
relevant cell with CIQ identifier) --> Tab Market Data: Fixed Income: Bond 
Price --> Date in Cell: Click on the first date in desired range --> Add 
Formula --> OK Apply bond price formula across all bonds and dates. Refresh the data: Capital IQ--> Refresh Data Optional: Insert Issue Name formula. Right Click on empty cell --> Insert Formula 
--> Enter Identifier: Cell (Click relevant cell with CIQ identifier) --> 
Tab Market Data: Fixed Income: Issue Name--> Add Formula --> 
OK​

Compare Experiments: a tool that uses AI to extract, organize, and summarize experiment details from multiple articles comparing them and their features. AI Reading Assistant: a tool for summarizing, analyzing, and answering questions about individual articles and book chapters available on ScienceDirect. Global Public Finance Credit Enhancements Bond Insurance is a guarantee to meet the principal and 
interest payments of an issue if the issuer is unable. The insurer receives an 
"up front" premium for the guarantee, which is determined primarily by the 
perceived risk associated with the financing.  Insurance is not purchased unless 
this cost is more than offset by the lower interest rate that can be incurred 
through use of insurance. A Certificate of Deposit is a debt instrument issued by a 
bank or a credit union that earns interest over the life of the debt at varying 
frequencies (monthly, quarterly, annually, etc). Collateralized is a pledge of interest in insured 
securities.  These securities are held by the enhancer in an amount sufficient 
to provide the issuer with liquidity support when debt-servicing funds are 
inadequate.  In the event of default or prepayment on mortgage loans, the 
enhancer will repurchase sufficient collateralized securities to provide the 
trustee with a stream of payments equal to the difference between the monies in 
the debt servicing fund and the amount required to make principal and interest 
payments. Corporation Guarantees operate much like a letter of 
credit.  A guaranty is the pledge of the faith and full credit of an 
institution, a government authority or a private corporation to back the 
complete and timely payment of principal and interest of the issue.  The most 
common guarantors are the parent corporations of bond profors, fiscally strong 
government authorities and insurance companies A Guaranteed Investment Contract , or GIC provides a safe 
haven for bond proceeds prior to their release on a given project.  Under the 
indenture, funds held by the trustees are fully invested pursuant to an 
agreement with the Obligated Group (typically the Profor ).   
The amount invested under the agreement and subsequent earnings are expected to 
be sufficient to pay the principal, the tender purchase price, and the interest 
on the bonds.  The GIC will terminate on the project fund release date, when no 
bonds are left outstanding, or upon a mandatory redemption. Investment Agreements provide municipal bond issuers with 
investment from highly rated financial institutions to meet liquidity needs as 
part of maintenance of a bond issue. The primary investment funds created 
include project/construction fund, escrow funds, float funds and reserve 
funds. A Letter of Credit (LOC) is a commitment, 
usually made by a commercial bank, to pay debt upon the occurrence of certain 
events specified under the terms of the commitment.  A letter of credit may also 
be used to pay the principal and interest if the issuer is unable or provide 
liquidity for the retirement of commercial paper or put bonds. The letter of 
credit may be drawn upon by the bond trustee either to make all debt service 
payments on the debt ( a ‘Direct Pay’ letter of credit ) or to 
cover an issuer’s default, bankruptcy, etc. ( a ‘Standby’ letter of 
credit ). Letters of credit are issued in short duration (3-5 years) and 
must be renewed or replaced several times over the life of the debt. Mortgage Backed Certificates are guaranteed by mortgage 
payments.  In these types of guarantees, investors receive payments out of the 
interest and principal on the underlying mortgages.  Typically the guarantor is 
a federal agency, such as the Government National Mortgage Association. (GNMA).  
Sometimes, banks may issue deals backed by conventional mortgages to sell to 
large institutional investors. Private Mortgage Insurance is a type of insurance that 
protects against loss resulting from a default on a mortgage loan. A Standby Purchase Agreement is also a commitment with a 
third party, usually a commercial bank, in which the third party agrees to 
purchase the bonds (typically variable rate obligations) in the event that they 
cannot be remarketed.  Unlike a letter of credit, a standby purchase agreement 
does not guarantee the payment of principal and interest by the issuer and is 
not an unconditional obligation to purchase the bonds. A Surety , provided exclusively by insurance companies, 
authorizes the trustee to make claims to the surety provider in order to obtain 
funds for payment of principal, tender purchase price and interest until the 
termination of the agreement​

Economics Research : U.S. economic forecasts and macro trends from the SIFMA Economist Roundtable. Insights : Research and commentary on market structure, trading trends, and timely topics. Capital Markets fact book : annual reference containing comprehensive data on the capital markets, investor participation, savings and investment, and securities industry. Municipal bond statistics. Credit Market Outlook reports. International research. General economic outlook. Time Period Covered Data trends to be more recent (going back 5-7 years) though some data is available prior to 2000. Access SIFMA website. Ask #Information Resources to purchase reports and subscriptions . Contact: Email #Information Resources with requests. Cost Some information is free, other publications (many of the reports, for example) are available for purchase; certain data require subscriptions, which can run into the thousands of dollars. page_372.body_text: Starmine Source StarMine How to Cite the Source LSEG StarMine Description The LSEG StarMine Awards for economic indicators and foreign exchange rates recognizes the firms and forecasters who provide the most accurate predictions for economic data releases and FX Rates in the Reuters Polls during a calendar year. The awards are announced in February of the following year. page_380.body_text: S3 Source S3 How to Cite the Source S3 Partners Description S3 Short Interest and Securities Finance data covers more than 60,000 global securities. The time series data includes financing rates (bid/ask/last), short interest, float data, open interest (long positions) and proprietary indexes (squeeze, crowded, momentum). Data points are broken up into four categories: Short Interest – Daily shorting activity for 60,000+ global securities Financing Rates – Unbiased bid, offer and last rates from all sides of the market Crowding – An indicator providing a measure of shorting and covering events relative to market float that predicts financing spikes in real-time Days-to-Cover – Number of days to close out all short positions Sample data: WF S3MomentumSqueeze 8-21-18to8-15-19.xlsx WF S3ShortInterest 8-21-18to8-15-19.xlsx WF S3Float 8-21-18to8-15-19.xlsx WF S3FinancingRates 8-21-18to8-15-19.xlsx Documentation: Data Overview - Short Interest v1.0.pdf Time Period Covered S3's data set and model are from 2015. S3 started distributing its data to clients in 2016. S3 does not save old versions of its model. Instead, it has point-in-time data (read more about this below). Access Two members of IR have access. Contact: #Information Resources Cost $1,000 per equity regardless of date range Important Notes S3 has $3T+ of assets under advisement and can live stream 5 million transactions across this asset base every day. As a result, S3 can provide a clear and comprehensive picture of the securities finance market in real time and fill the gap between regulatory publication dates with accurate short interest data. S3's goal is to provide the most comprehensive and accurate short interest data with the information available at the time S3 provide it. For this reason, when new short interest regulatory data is released, S3 revises its projections to reflect this new source of information. That said, S3 recognizes that its process for revising its projections can be problematic for clients who use S3 data to feed their internal models and conduct backtesting. For any client who needs it, S3 is able to provide a "point in time" data set that shows its data set as it appeared before it was updated to reflect new information from regulatory filings. Following are some notes from inquiries case teams have posed to S3: CR: When working with the S3 data, we learned that the data (both rates and short interest) is reported based on settled loans and therefore correspond to settlement dates not trade dates.  This means that for securities that settle on a T+2 or T+3 day cycle, if one wants to assess conditions an investor faced at the time of the trade, rate and short interest variables need to be shifted back by the appropriate number of days. Some questions we've asked S3 and their answers: CR: Do you know whether the "offer rate" reported by S3 Partners represents the average offer rate on a given day, or the last reported offer rate? S3: Offer Rate is not merely an average, but it is a "fair rate" that hedge funds should be paying for a particular stock borrow. It also takes into consideration the recent supply & demand characteristics for a particular security as well as directionality of recent rate flows. We are calculating what we believe to be the overall cost basis of stock borrow costs of a prime broker and adding on a "fair" profit spread for that security coupled with directionality and volatility of rate activity to come up with an offer rate that is both appropriate for the lender to charge and the borrower to pay. CR: For your measure of short interest, does that represent all short interest in the market, or only the short interest from certain types of market participants? S3: This includes any proprietary information we have on the short side which includes $3.5 trillion in assets along with the exchange reported numbers. This does not include all participants, for example if Goldman Sachs or any prime broker were to approve a short and they were utilizing their internal supply they would not have to publicly disclose this to the exchanges CR: For the last rate variable, can you confirm that the lending fee is an annual interest rate on the value of the stock borrowed? Or is it presented in some other unit? S3: The attached data dictionary will give you the definition of each of our rate fields, (bid, offer and last), the bid rate on any given day is the amount you would earn on that day (quantity* closing price/360) is the dollar amount you would earn on that day. Assuming the rate didn't move the entire year that would be the annualized number you would earn. This has nothing to do with internalization but just the mechanics of the marketplace. That's why we came up with the S3% float to account for these situations and effectively adding the number of shares short back into the denominator. S3 has $3T+ of assets under advisement and can live stream 5 million transactions across this asset base every day. As a result, S3 can provide a clear and comprehensive picture of the securities finance market in real time and fill the gap between regulatory publication dates with accurate short interest data.

S3's goal is to provide the most comprehensive and accurate short interest data with the information available at the time S3 provide it. For this reason, when new short interest regulatory data is released, S3 revises its projections to reflect this new source of information.

That said, S3 recognizes that its process for revising its projections can be problematic for clients who use S3 data to feed their internal models and conduct backtesting. For any client who needs it, S3 is able to provide a "point in time" data set that shows its data set as it appeared before it was updated to reflect new information from regulatory filings.

CR: For your measure of short interest, does that represent all short interest in the market, or only the short interest from certain types of market participants?

S3:This includes any proprietary information we have on the short side which includes $3.5 trillion in assets along with the exchange reported numbers. page_390.body_text: ​ Scite Source ​Scite How to Cite the Source ​Scite Description ​Scite is an AI-powered platform that helps researchers discover and evaluate articles by providing context for citations and classifying whether they support, mention, or contrast the cited claim.   Scite draws its information from databases, full-text journal articles, and metadata from the sciences, including open access articles and some publishers like Wiley and Cambridge University Press. Scite Features: Smart Citations: Provides context for citations and classifies them as supporting, mentioning, or contrasting. Assistant: A generative AI tool that can take research questions and return a synthesized summary of recent academic literature regarding that question. Browser Extension: Allows users to see Smart Citations anywhere they're reading a scientific article online. Scite can be used for various purposes, including: Literature Review: Understanding how a particular paper has been cited and interpreted by others. Evaluating Research: Assessing the credibility and impact of research papers. Identifying Research Gaps: Finding areas where there is disagreement or a lack of research. Training Video led by Scite reps.  (Link expries 4/11/2027) IMPORTANT: Please refer to the Scite Guidelines when using Scite. These guidelines were developed internally to help users understand the limitations of Scite and maximize the effectiveness of the platform. Time Period Covered ​ Access Access is for Associates and above.  ​ Contact: Please email #Information Resources for access. Cost Access is $600 per user per calendar month. IR will check with users at the end of each month to confirm continued access or changes to the matter being charged. Important Notes ​ Scite Guidelines FINAL 2025.04.23.docx AI Restrictions ​ AI Definitions/Capabilities ​Scite uses AI to analyze articles Updated 3/31/25 SRC

page_395.body_text: ​ TAQ Q&A 1. Questions on column fields / specific data issue A. Refer to the TAQ User guides: TAQ User Guide Custom TAQ Client Specification 2. Are there data for indices in TAQ? A. Data for indices are available in TAQ as long as the correct tickers are provided. For example, SPY tracks the S&P 500 index. However, the proper ticker depends on the time period. Make sure to check or recommend the case team that requests the data to check what the proper ticker is. 3. Quotes data availability A. All quotes (bids / asks throughout the day) for a security are available as Quotes data. Quotes data are downloaded from the TAQ program using the same procedure as we download Trade data by checking the corresponding tick box and entering the file path to which the data is to be downloaded in the Quote Output field. B. Given the size of the quotes data file, some of the quotes data might not be loaded onto the LAN. If you receive a message that the data is not being loaded, please contact Menlo Park to download the quote data directly from the CDs. C. Also, beginning in 2006, quotes data for certain dates are split into 2 files. Make sure to check the data to see if you get a complete set of quotes for the day. If you suspect you are not getting the complete set of quotes, refer to the following file for further instructions and request the West Coast for help on loading the specific data from the CDs onto the LAN: < \\Crwfs2\TAQ\ jan_2006_letter.pdf > 4. Intraday charts A. Intraday charts can be plotted using the TAQ Macro in Excel. If there is data overrun issue (Excel has rows limit), you can: i. Split the data into two spreadsheets for charting and then combine the charts ii. Chart in SAS.  Example codes are available on Portal. 5. Post June 2007 TAQ data A. Post June 2007 data are to be requested from IR.

page_410.body_text: Talkwalker Source Talkwalker How to Cite the Source ​ Description Talkwalker is a Social Listening and Social Monitoring platform. They have access to social media, online news, blogs, and forums.  The database can search through text, videos, and images.  The standard amount of historical data is a year back. TikTok was an official partner, but searching has been put on hold as of September of 2024.  The TikTok searching should return in the first quarter of 2025.  With the new API there should be text and video searching across TikTok. Instagram- They can monitor hashtags, but it has to be a public account.  You can search to see the number of posts for a certain hashtag, but only 24 hours back.  You can search on public comments, and tags on public comments or public videos. Facebook- you can search through public pages and public comments for keywords. They do collect Apple reviews for the last 50 reviews.  They collect the full review content, the rating, the timestamp, and some metadata of the author if available, such as the name. Talkwater coverage.png Time Period Covered The standard historical data is 1 year back.  For Instagram and Facebook they can go back 400 days. Access Please email #Information Resources for access. Contact: Luca Loiacono luca.loiacono@hootsuite.com 647-515-5822 Cost They offer a yearly license for historical social media searching.  They do not charge by user; they instead charge by volume of data.  3 million data points would be $10,800 per year as of 07/25. Reviews would be $16,800 for access to that searching platform, and then an additional $6,000 for a reviews package (Reviews IQ Apps) for 50 review channels as of 07/25. Important Notes ​TalkWalker was acquired by Hootsuite in 2024. AI Restrictions ​ AI Definitions/Capabilities ​ Updated0 07/25/2025_SAT

page_411.body_text: ​ TREPP Source Trepp ( TreppCRE ) How to Cite the Source Trepp, Inc. Description Trepp is a provider of data, analytics, and technology solutions for the structured finance, commercial real estate, and banking markets.  They offer numerous tools for risk management, market research, and performance monitoring.  Trepp tracks industrial, lodging, mixed-use, multifamily, office, retail, and alternative properties. The TreppCRE product provides access to commercial property data and tracks up to 4 million properties.  The database includes sales transactions, lease and tax assessment data allowing for benchmarking and evaluation on CRE properties, loans and markets.  Primarily US coverage but some Canadian and European data is available. Access is through a front-end platform and includes analytics tools. Data can also be delivered through raw data via an API or flat files at a significantly higher subscription cost. Time Period Covered Real estate and property data:  1997 onwards Access Cornerstone does not currently subscribe. Contact Email #Information Resources. Cost As of 02/2025 the cost of TreppCRE was approximately $50,000 (5 seats) and $65,000 (10 seats.) Important Notes Trepp also has a modeling product (TreppDefault) which allows users to forecast commercial real estate loan Probability of Default (PD), Loss Given Default (LGD), Expected Loss (EL), and Current Expected Credit Losses (CECL) at the loan and portfolio level. AI Restrictions At Cornerstone we cannot: Use machine learning or certain kinds of AI with [their] data feeds Export data en masse and import it to another system Terms of Use AI Definitions/Capabilities Data Science team is exploring using AI and machine learning AI is currently used in the search feature in TreppCRE (Ex: "ask the search bar "show me distressed properties in NYC".  And the platform will know how to perform the search.) Updated 12/08/2025_bmc

page_415.body_text: ​U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development's (HUD's) Office of Policy Development and Research (PD&R) Source U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development's (HUD's) Office of Policy Development and Research (PD&R) How to Cite the Source Office of Policy Development and Research, U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development Description HUD USER is an information source for housing and community development researchers, academics, policymakers, and the American public that is maintained by the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development's (HUD's) Office of Policy Development and Research (PD&R). We only have access to consensus data from the contributor models and there are no entitlements for detailed data. Description The Wall Street Journal is an American newspaper based in New York City. The newspaper provides extensive coverage of news, especially business and finance. Time Period Covered Most current three months Access Cornerstone has WSJ Group Access.  It means you will be able to easily access the WSJ from anywhere without being logged into Cornerstone's network after your initial set up. Follow these instructions . If you have any issues logging in, please follow the instructions below: Clear cookies by entering www.wsj.com/delete_cookies on the browser's address bar. Log out from the WSJ account by entering www.wsj.com/logout on the browser's address bar. Then try logging in again with your credentials. Cornerstone also has access to all verticals of WSJ Pro, which are Central Banking, Private Equity, Venture Capital, Bankruptcy, Cybersecurity and Artificial Intelligence. ​This is a completely different subscription than the one we have for the Wall Street Journal. To learn more about WSJ Pro visit our page HERE . Contact: Cost No Cost Important Notes For articles older than three months, please email #Information Resources with requests. Setting up WSJ alerts Once you are logged into the WSJ Online using the hyperlink in the above "Access" section, you can scroll down to the end of the WSJ Homepage and find the link for "Alerts" under the heading "Tools & Formats".  Alerts can be set using keywords or ticker symbols (this works for US securities only) Alerts can be delivered in real time or set to deliver once a day at a specified time.  Alerts can only be delivered to one email address.  All alerts will share this single email address.  (i.e. If you are setting different alerts with the intention of delivering them to different colleagues, you will have to send them to yourself first and forward them on individually.) Just a reminder that content from these subscriptions are for individual use and/or research purposes only. Please contact #Information Resources if you want to produce articles for a case or share externally and we'll try to get a shareable copy for you. page_432.body_text: WebCivil Supreme+ Source WebCivil Supreme How to Cite the Source New York State Unified Court System WebCivil Supreme Description WebCivil Supreme contains information on both Active and Disposed Civil Supreme Court cases in all 62 counties of New York State. You may search for cases by Index Number, Party Name, Attorney/Firm Name or Justice, and produce calendars for a specific Attorney/Firm or by Justice or Part. You can sign up for eTrack case tracking service and receive email updates and appearance reminders for cases you wish to follow. Time Period Covered This varies by county. Because each county added its entire active caseload when it began using the current case management system, there may be cases which began earlier than the following dates: Nassau (1979-1980), Westchester and Suffolk (1981), Dutchess, Orange, Putnam and Rockland (1983), Bronx, Kings, New York and Queens (1986), Erie and Richmond (1988). The remaining counties were added in 2002. Access Open to public. Just visit http://iapps.courts.state.ny.us/webcivil/FCASMain Contact: Cost Free Important Notes The FAQ is very helpful to read before diving into NY State Supreme Court cases IMPORTANT FOR FINDING/TRACKING NEWLY FILED CASES: In many state and federal courts, a judge is assigned as soon as the case is filed. New York takes a different approach. Under the New York rules, a judge is not assigned to a case until one of the parties files a Request for Judicial Intervention (or "RJI") Form with the clerk. Prior to the plaintiff filing an RJI, the court's only role is to issue an index number and be a repository for filed documents. This one-page form triggers the court's actual entry into the case. Why the unusual system? One guess would be that allowing cases to be filed without immediately involving a judge encourages out-of-court settlements, as there is a filing fee for the RJI. So what does this mean? WebCivil Supreme only displays cases for which an RJI has been filed. To find a new case opened in New York County (Manhattan) before an RJI has been filed, you may search by party within the County Clerk's site, Scroll AI Restrictions This site may not be accessed by any automated program ("bot") for the purpose of extracting data for any use. AI Definitions/Capabilities ​ Updated 12-4-25_hg

page_443.body_text: Use the Enterprise Wiki to create a single, go-to place for knowledge sharing and project management across the enterprise. Enterprise Wikis are simple to use, flexible, and lightweight in features. They are quick and easy to create, and you can easily add links to other information systems, corporate directories, or applications. By using an Enterprise Wiki, you can avoid email overload, provide structure to new and existing information, and encourage collaboration. This helps build consensus among team members. Working with content - text, graphics or video - is as easy as working in any word processing application, such as Microsoft Word. Use the Rich Text Editor to enhance the formatting of content, apply styles to text, reorganize or spell check your content, insert and format tables, and embed graphics or video. You can do all these things without leaving the wiki page. transportation system, including its physical components, safety record, 
economic performance, the human and natural environment, and national security.

quarterly. A date in parenthesis after the table name indicates when a table was 
updated. Latest updates are in bold. Chapter 1,  Section B - Vehicle, Aircraft,

business consultation, ALG provides 1) Residual value forecasting, 2) Consulting 
services for manufacturers, financial institutions, and fleet companies, 3) 
Lease and loan portfolio risk analysis and securitization valuations, 4) Data 
analysis products, 5) Custom modeling tools for residual values and 
remarketing. Wards Auto WARD'S has covered the auto industry for more than 80 years and produces 
monthly magazines (AutoWorld), weekly and twice-monthly newsletters (Automotive 
Reports, Engine and Vehicle Technology Update), and database products (WARD'S 
AutoInfoBank.)  A widely cited and highly respected source in the auto 
industry. MotorIntelligence (AutoData Corp) Founded in 1990, Autodata Corporation provides automotive statistical data, 
market intelligence and analysis to the OEMs, Wall Street Analysts and financial 
institutions. Autodata specializes in electronic delivery of custom management 
reports, data and proprietary analysis in a near-real time environment. Autodata 
is the primary outsource supplier of on-going confidential market analysis to 
major brands. Autodata also serves as an information resource for the 
international media including print, wire service and broadcast journalists. 
Autodata Corporation is affiliated with Productive Access, Inc., who provides 
specialized automotive software solutions and support services in Detroit, Los 
Angeles and through agents world-wide. The Motor Intelligence web site incorporates the core data resources 
produced by Autodata Corporation and makes them available via a powerful and 
easy to use web interface. Data is accessible via on demand queries as well as 
snapshot of reports which can be printed directly from a web browser. Manheim Consulting Manheim Consulting Data Services Auction Inventory and Results module gives 
you direct access to millions of transactions to transform data results into 
meaningful patterns and answer complex questions. SMMT (UK Society of Motor Manufacturers and Traders) Produces reports on various aspects of the UK Automotive Industry, as 
well as a general  UK Automotive Industry overview . Publishes data on various aspects of the UK auto industry, including 
manufacturing data, export reports, and industry forecasts. ACEA (European Automobile Manufacturers Association) ACEA is an advocate for the automobile industry in 
Europe, representing manufacturers of passenger cars, vans, trucks and buses 
with production sites in the EU. ACEA regularly releases updated Economic and Market Reports on the 
automotive industry, with the latest figures on the economy as well as 
registrations, production and trade of passenger cars and commercial vehicles. 
It compiles Key Figures on the industry - and has 
a statistic section on its webpage.​
